newsitem.title: USA: Summit Technology to divest Vision Center.
newsitem.headline: Summit Technology to divest Vision Center.

text.p: Summit Technologies Inc. said Thursday it plans to sell or spin off its growing but unprofitable Vision Centre clinic business to concentrate on its core opthalmic laser systems operations.

"While we are excited about the growth this business is experiencing we have heard our customers' concerns about our being directly involved in the same business as they are," said Verne Sharma, Summit chief executive and president.
"This divestiture is the first major step in redefining the company's strategy and future direction."
Summit's 19 outpatient Vision Centres, which use laser systems to correct shortsightedness, will be treated as a discontinued operation from now on, the Waltham, Mass.-based company said.
Summit's Lens Express subsidiary sells contact lenses and related products.
Summit's stock rose 37.5 cents to $7.75 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
